objective: Minimize wall-clock time to first data-conditioned audible prototype.

A_EVIDENCE_EXPANSION.action: Expand free-evidence massive-hit cohort using public YouTube plus independent chart/certification/streaming evidence.

B_ANALYZER.action: Immediately process every eligible prototype song with globally frozen Analyzer parameters; do not wait for target N.

C_MATRIX.action: Rebuild provisional Matrix X after each new strict-pass fingerprint and monitor usable feature coverage.

D_GENERATION.trigger: First genre/style cohort with >=3 strict-pass songs and usable TMT feature coverage
D_GENERATION.action: Build provisional cached cohort, compile descriptive constraints, generate three controlled variants, render essential audio and record TTFP.

rules: Prototype evidence remains separate from final scientific Sample 1.
N=20 is an engineering prototype target, not an inferential adequacy claim.
Generation may start before N=20 when a minimally populated coherent cohort exists.
Every generated constraint must trace to observed cohort fields.
Online generation performs zero corpus search and zero corpus reanalysis.
